environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS cluster in us-east-1. Pod runs with default service account. Network policy allows all egress from the signing-service namespace. ENABLE_CALLBACKS=true. The pod can reach the EC2 instance metadata service (169.254.169.254), internal services, and the HSM proxy at hsm-proxy.internal:8443. No egress filtering or URL validation on callback URLs. IAM role attached to node has s3:*, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions for legacy reasons.
